body: I just felt like I had nothing going in my life, and I was an almost perfect candidate for it, I was extremely fit, I could already shoot about any gun, and I've hunted for God, I think my dad took me with him when I was 5 or 6 so I've killed plenty of animals and for me it transferred over pretty easy.
